purpose: Prepare crate 0.0.39 from a source tree that carries the V3-C4 work (boundary instruments, the error-leak fix, the consumer-closure engine, the CMS batch and the post-CMS re-measurement) but is otherwise unchanged. rebuild.target_dir_note: build_phase2.sh hardwires CRATE=/work/target/release/libopenssl_rs.a and the rlib/--extern paths, so CARGO_TARGET_DIR was unset and the script's own /work/target was used. The subphase brief's default line names CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/court/target; using it would have linked a stale pre-bump archive. TMPDIR stayed on /work/court/tmp. One heavy command at a time; host MemAvailable was about 60 GB before the build.
rebuild.identity_delta_cause: The crate version participates in rustc crate metadata, so every linked object changes even though S67 changes no src/. The rebuild also rewrote forensics/atlas/implemented-surface.json (crate-archive sha256 and compiler-emitted counts), a build-product observation rather than contract evidence.
